title: Copper Remover
description: Texturepack to make copper ore blocks look like stone / deepslate. Compatible with any other texturepack.
body:
Texturepack to make copper ore blocks look like stone / deepslate. Compatible with any other texturepack.

**I made this texturepack because i was always mistook copper ore patches for iron ones**.
